name: gizza-ai/video-frame-extract
summary: Extract a single frame from a video at a given timestamp

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

tool.description: Extract a single frame from a video at the given timestamp (seconds), output as PNG. The PNG is naturally chainable into image-resize, image-crop, or image-convert via ref. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).
